redFirst.basis: `node --test tests/readme.test.mjs` in a throwaway tree at HEAD exited 1, but its output carries no test tally this command reads, so an assertion failure cannot be told from a crash - no test is known to have been collected: no tally or error reader matched its output, so no line of it is quoted as decisive; run without CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR, OLDPWD; no ignored dependency directory linked from the project root; the user's .npmrc in the home directory dropped (every run has a fresh home); deadline: 480s, the default - the command is not a sweep naming suites, so there is no recorded cost to size it from

outcome.technical: README.md rewritten: Status (release candidate for 1.0.0; version set at release), Install (local-dev path now a placeholder), Commands table generated from commands/*.md frontmatter (description and argument-hint verbatim, pipes escaped), What a build delivers (nodes with file:line evidence, typed edges with verified/inferred/external confidence, entities with declared/observed/inferred provenance, relations, access/CRUD, sequences, views, offline viewer, opt-in issues overlay outside the repo, update and SessionStart staleness hook, self-build counts 63/28/16/4/5 from the evals README), What a build costs (one table: evals 1-5 plus self-build, with-skill cost, baseline, orchestrator turns, orchestrator max context, iteration-1 'before' as cost/turns/context, result graded against evals.json, cited evidence files; eval 2 row = the three P11.2 runs on the current reviewer as ranges; caveats: eval 3 two flows, evals 3/5 baselines not like for like, eval 2 recall per reviewer incl. P8 0.67/0.53/0.53, evals 2/4 baselines are iteration 1, turn overruns), How these numbers were measured (cost-profile.mjs --json --basename on stream-json, rate table 2026-10-31, last result event, evals.json grading, score-recall.mjs, node --test more than 400 cases, pointers to the evals README and evidence dir). tests/readme.test.mjs added: r1 command table == commands/*.md frontmatter; r2 every cost/baseline/turn/context/before cell == total.costUsd / orchestrator row of the cited evidence file, grades out of evals.json expectation counts, rate date matches; r3 no machine path (evals.test PATH_LIKE), no planned/pre-release/not-usable-yet wording, status release candidate for 1.0.0; r4 delivers section names the model contents and its self-build counts equal the evals README self-build row, method section names the scripts and the test count is a lower bound of the static test() count (447 now); r5 tamper cases for each check. Command: node --test tests/readme.test.mjs -> exit 0, 5 tests, 5 pass. Dependants of README.md: .claude/audit.config.json lists README.md as an exempt glob - still correct, unaffected. tests/diffmap, glob, prescan-core, review-scan, staleness and tests/fixtures/evals/issues.json use 'README.md' only as a fixture file name in temp dirs - still correct, they do not read this README. tests/evals.test.mjs reads the evals README, not this one - still correct. tests/readme.test.mjs is new and no file names it. Not run: the full node --test gate and the denylist test (runsGate own-tests); tests/readme.test.mjs is untracked, so the denylist scan (tracked files only) sees it only once staged.
outcome.descriptive: The top-level README now tells a prospective user what the plugin does, its real commands, what a build delivers and what it costs per eval, with every figure tied by a test to the evidence profile it cites.
